text_en: The levitical priests, the whole tribe of Levi, shall have no allotment or inheritance within Israel. They may eat the sacrifices that are the Lord ’s portion
text_cn: 肋未人司祭即全肋未支派，在以色列中没有分子和产业，他们靠献与上主的火祭祭品，和他们应得的一分维持生活。

text_en: but they shall have no inheritance among the other members of the community; the Lord is their inheritance, as he promised them.
text_cn: 他在兄弟中间没有产业；照上主向他所说的，上主自己要作他们的产业。

text_en: This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those offering a sacrifice, whether an ox or a sheep: they shall give to the priest the shoulder, the two jowls, and the stomach.
text_cn: 这是司祭由人民应得的一分，就是宰杀牛羊作祭献的人，应将前腿、两腮和胃脏给司祭；

text_en: The first fruits of your grain, your wine, and your oil, as well as the first of the fleece of your sheep, you shall give him.
text_cn: 初收的五谷、酒、油和初剪的羊毛，亦应给他，

text_en: For the Lord your God has chosen Levi out of all your tribes, to stand and minister in the name of the Lord , him and his sons for all time.
text_cn: 因为上主你的天主由各支派中拣选了他，叫他和他的子孙，时时以上主的名义服役供职。

text_en: If a Levite leaves any of your towns, from wherever he has been residing in Israel, and comes to the place that the Lord will choose (and he may come whenever he wishes),
text_cn: 如果一个住在以色列境内任何城镇的肋未人，离开了本地，一心一意地要到上主所选的地方去，

text_en: then he may minister in the name of the Lord his God, like all his fellow-Levites who stand to minister there before the Lord .
text_cn: 他可因上主的名义供职，如同在那里侍立于上主面前的肋未弟兄们一样，

text_en: They shall have equal portions to eat, even though they have income from the sale of family possessions.
text_cn: 分享同样的口粮，不必变卖祖产。

text_en: When you come into the land that the Lord your God is giving you, you must not learn to imitate the abhorrent practices of those nations.
text_cn: 几时你进入了上主你的天主赐给你的土地，不要仿效那些异民做可憎恶的事。

text_en: No one shall be found among you who makes a son or daughter pass through fire, or who practices divination, or is a soothsayer, or an augur, or a sorcerer,
text_cn: 在你中间，不可容许人使自己的儿子或女儿经过火， 也不可容许人占卜、算卦、行妖术或魔术；

text_en: or one who casts spells, or who consults ghosts or spirits, or who seeks oracles from the dead.
text_cn: 或念咒、问鬼、算命和求问死者；

text_en: For whoever does these things is abhorrent to the Lord ; it is because of such abhorrent practices that the Lord your God is driving them out before you.
text_cn: 因为凡做这些事的人，都是上主所憎恶的；其实就是为了这些可憎恶的事，上主你的天主才把他们由你面前赶走。

text_en: You must remain completely loyal to the Lord your God.
text_cn: 你应一心一意属于上主你的天主。

text_en: Although these nations that you are about to dispossess do give heed to soothsayers and diviners, as for you, the Lord your God does not permit you to do so.
text_cn: 你要赶走的这些民族，听信了算卦和占卜的人；但上主你的天主为你却不是这样安排；

text_en: The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you shall heed such a prophet.
text_cn: 上主你的天主，要由你中间，由你兄弟中，为你兴起一位像我一样的先知，你们应听信他。

text_en: This is what you requested of the Lord your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly when you said: “If I hear the voice of the Lord my God any more, or ever again see this great fire, I will die. ”
text_cn: 正如你在曷（hé）勒布集会之日，求上主你的天主说：“惟愿我再不听见上主我的天主的声音，再不看见这烈火，免得我死亡。”

text_en: Then the Lord replied to me: “They are right in what they have said.
text_cn: 上主遂对我说：“他们说得有理，

text_en: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their own people; I will put my words in the mouth of the prophet, who shall speak to them everything that I command.
text_cn: 我要由他们的兄弟中，给他们兴起一位像你一样的先知，我要将我的话放在他口中，他要向他们讲述我所吩咐他的一切。

text_en: Anyone who does not heed the words that the prophet shall speak in my name, I myself will hold accountable.
text_cn: 若有人不听信他因我的名所说的话，我要亲自同他算账。

text_en: But any prophet who speaks in the name of other gods, or who presumes to speak in my name a word that I have not commanded the prophet to speak—that prophet shall die. ”
text_cn: 但是，若一位先知擅敢因我的名说我没有吩咐他说的话，或因其他神的名说话，这位先知应该处死。”

text_en: You may say to yourself, “How can we recognize a word that the Lord has not spoken? ”
text_cn: 也许你心里想：“我们怎能知道上主未曾说过这话？”

text_en: If a prophet speaks in the name of the Lord but the thing does not take place or prove true, it is a word that the Lord has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously; do not be frightened by it.
text_cn: 几时一位先知因上主之名说话，若他的话不实现，不应验，这话就不是上主说的，是先知擅自说的，你不用怕他。
